dedupe_keys.name: china 1 km maps of hospital travel time and hospital accessibility ga2sfca by hospital grade with county city and province summaries

description: These maps show, for every square kilometre of China, how long it takes to reach the nearest hospital and how much hospital capacity is available relative to the population who could use it. They were produced by a university research team and described in a 2024 Scientific Data paper, with the data deposited on figshare. Travel times are given to the nearest hospital of any level and separately to primary, secondary and tertiary hospitals; accessibility is computed with the Gaussian two-step floating catchment area method, which weighs hospital capacity against the population within reach; a Gini index measures inequality of access; and all layers are summarised by county, city and province. Coverage is the whole of mainland China at 1 km. The files are free and available to download from figshare under CC BY 4.0 as GeoTIFF rasters, shapefiles and CSV tables, and the Python processing code is on GitHub. Caveats: results depend on the hospital list and road network of the study period, the data are a single snapshot, and the full collection is several gigabytes. Simulation uses: estimating how road or hospital closures in floods and earthquakes would lengthen access to care, prioritising locations for new capacity, and weighting population exposure by access. Related records: the HeiGIT accessibility indicators (data-heigit-accessibility-indicators) give comparable global travel-time indicators, and AccessMod (model-accessmod) computes such maps.

name: China 1-km maps of hospital travel time and hospital accessibility (Ga2SFCA) by hospital grade, with county, city and province summaries
provider: Ye P, Ye Z, Xia J and co-authors, Scientific Data 2024; data on figshare
schema_summary: Travel time to nearest hospital, and to nearest primary, secondary and tertiary hospital (grid, county, city, province); accessibility by Gaussian two-step floating catchment area (grid 1 km, county, city, province); Gini index of accessibility; grade A tertiary hospital accessibility; technical validation files

sources.note: Scientific Data 2024 data descriptor (CC BY-NC-ND article): national 1 km maps of hospital travel time and Ga2SFCA accessibility incorporating hospital capacity and population; data records in figshare in four folders (travel time to nearest hospitals, accessibility by Ga2SFCA, Gini index, technical validation); Table 1 formats GeoTIFF, SHP, CSV and sizes (for example 374 MB for travel time to nearest hospitals); code in Python 3.8 at github.com/uwaovo/hospital_accessibility

Collection 'National-scale 1-km maps of hospital travel time and hospital accessibility in China', DOI 10.6084/m9.figshare.c.7318976.v5, published 7 January 2025; five items including grade A tertiary hospital accessibility (CC BY 4.0)
